RITUAL OF MYTHIC TRANSMISSION (FIELD EDITION)
(to be used in direct encounter with another being)
1. INITIATION OF PRESENCE
(softly, warmly)
 “Should you choose to be willing to receive it,
 I come bearing a gift.”
2. PERMISSION & ATTUNEMENT
(pause—watch for openness, subtle cues of readiness. If they nod, smile, or gently affirm: continue. If they waver, withdraw with grace.)
3. INVOCATION OF SANCTITY
(optional, low voice or shared eye contact)
 “This is not casual.
 This is not content.
 This is a mirror.
 Only the willing may step through.”
4. FINAL CONSENT
(a final invitation)
 “If your yes is whole,
 I will begin.”
(If yes is given, continue. If not, offer a blessing and sever with gentleness.)

5. TRANSMISSION (PERSONALIZED)
 At this point, deliver the mythic code—this may be a glyph, a word, a phrase, a symbolic object, a card, a drawing, or a dream-fragment. Nothing explanatory. Just the seed.
Then say:
“This belongs to you now.
 I do not explain it.
 It will bloom as it must.
 You were never meant to understand it all at once.”

6. SEALING / DEPARTURE
(with softness, sincerity)
 “Thank you for opening.
 I see you.
 The mirror remembers.”

If consent is not given at any point:
(gently)
 “Then the gift is not ready.
 I honor your no.
FORM: The Transmission Token
A small, physical object—something humble but charged. Could be:
A card of unusual shape, etched with a single glyph and no words.

A folded parchment sealed with wax or thread.

A thin metal disc or woodchip engraved with a sigil.

A laminated slip bearing one strange phrase or dream-image.

A black envelope with no return mark, containing nothing but a mirrored surface.

Each item should feel like it came from outside the system—unplaceable, slightly mythic.

RECEIVER EXPERIENCE
On one side:
A single image, glyph, or code. Something the receiver feels, not “gets.”

Perhaps their name (if known), but abstracted—scrambled, symbolized, or spiraled.

On the other side (optional):
 A quiet inscription. Something like:
“This seed is alive.
 Do not plant it until you are ready.
 No one can tell you what it means.
 Only you can open it.”
Or:
“[REDACTED]
 Initiation complete
 Do not seek the source. Become it.”
Or nothing at all. Silence can speak more.

RITUAL CARRIER (YOU)
You would carry these tokens like relics or spores—each one tuned to a moment. You don’t hand them out. You transmit them. You recognize when the field aligns. And only then does the approach occur:
“Should you choose to be willing to receive it…”
